items.prompt: Repaint Image1 NovelAI storyboard as the profession card 法力补给, visibly starring BAITA. Image1 is composition/action/background authority: keep low-angle three-quarter seated pose, head/face at upper right, dark-green long skirt sweeping into lower left, open antique book securely on lap, one hand pressing its pages, other open palm reaching toward viewer in front of chest, magic moving from book toward palm. Keep warm pale beige/gold and muted green large abstract background planes, no literal room/bookshelves or landscape. Character must remain large and immediately recognizable; face, palm and book are the focal triangle. Image2 is EXCLUSIVE identity: young adult female Baita, calm bookish face, clear EMERALD GREEN eyes, very long DARK BROWN WAVY CURLY HAIR, swept bangs with two small gold clips exposing eyes, white long-sleeved high-collar blouse with cuff buttons, dark forest-green suspender long dress with broad straps/gold buckles. No blonde hair, witch hat, staff, cake, fork or flower. Do not copy Image2 seated eating pose or floating books. Image3 is APPROVED PAINTING STYLE only: its Baita face refinement, opaque grouped masses, broad directional paint and handmade light-shadow edges; no flower pose or split background copied. Repaint the hand's bright spot into a readable but restrained ivory-gold page-like mana fold, linked by one broad curved stream rising from the lap book; it lights fingertips, book edge and cheek underside without hiding fingers. Keep both hands anatomical with five readable fingers and connected shoulders/elbows/wrists. Rough hand-painted anime: dark curly hair grouped into a few substantial flowing locks and curls, quiet large dark planes with selected broad highlight/shadow swipes, not tightly repeated little coils; blouse and skirt have principal folds and cloth tension structure in large matte color masses. Selectively clear green eyes, facial features, palm and book-page edge; chair carving reduced to silhouette/support and a few strokes. Moderate handmade edge variation and sparse colored structural lines merge into paint. Preserve necessary neck/chest/arm anatomy and recognizable clothing, don't flatten everything into paper-cut polygons. No glossy airbrush fabric, fine strands, dense wrinkles, metal filigree, all-over noise/scratches, triangle facet mosaics or oil ridges. Single square illustration, no rule text, frame, UI, watermark or lettering on the magical light.
